sigma_rules.title: Potential Kerberos Coercion by Spoofing SPNs via DNS Manipulation

logsource.definition:
By default these events are not logged by default for MicrosoftDNS objects in Active Directory.
To enable detection, configure an AuditRule on the DNS object container with the "CreateChild" permission for the "Everyone" principal.
This can be accomplished using tools such as Set-AuditRule (see https://github.com/OTRF/Set-AuditRule).

sigma_rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

strategies.name: Detect DHCP Spoofing Across Linux, Windows, and macOS

analytics.name: Analytic 1290
analytics.guidance: Detects rogue DHCP server activity and anomalous DHCP OFFER/ACK messages assigning unexpected DNS or gateway values. Detection correlates DHCP server role changes, DHCP exhaustion warnings, and sudden network configuration changes across endpoints.

tuning.description: List of known DHCP servers; unexpected sources are suspicious.
Interval to correlate DHCP OFFER/ACK anomalies with subsequent misconfigurations.

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: DHCP OFFER or ACK with unauthorized DNS/gateway parameters

analytics.name: Analytic 1291
analytics.guidance: Detects rogue DHCP activity by monitoring syslog for dhclient messages assigning unauthorized DNS/gateway values. Packet capture or IDS can detect multiple competing DHCP OFFERs from non-authorized servers.

tuning.description: Expected MAC addresses of DHCP servers on subnet.
Number of suspicious DHCP leases before raising an alert.

log_sources.name: linux:syslog
log_sources.channel: suspicious DHCP lease assignment with unexpected DNS or gateway

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Gratuitous or duplicate DHCP OFFER packets from non-legitimate servers

analytics.name: Analytic 1292
analytics.guidance: Detects DHCP spoofing by monitoring unified logs for unexpected DHCP ACK/OFFER parameters and correlating with packet captures for multiple DHCP servers. Behavioral emphasis is on inconsistent DNS and gateway assignments that redirect traffic.

tuning.description: Expected DNS server list; deviations may indicate spoofing.
Threshold for number of anomalous DHCP responses before alerting.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: new DHCP configuration with anomalous DNS or router values

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Multiple DHCP OFFER responses for a single DISCOVER
